DS_RESULTS LIST DESCRIPTION and RULES
-------------------------------------

The DS_Results list is an unmoderated list for patients who have undergone the 
duodenal switch (BPD/DS, DGB/DS, LG/DS, etc.) obesity surgery procedure and are 
at least 6 months post-op.

This list is a place for us to post milestones, updates and status reports. The 
goal is to build an archive where people who are researching the Duodenal 
Switch procedure can look to get a sense of how we're faring over the long-term 
after our surgery, including positives and negatives, both physical and 
emotional.

Posting is restricted to DS post-ops who are 6 months and beyond. 

Everyone is welcome to join, but please do not post to the list unless you are 
a DS patient at least 6 months post-op. This rule will allow archive readers to 
get a realistic sense of our overall experience beyond the initial recovery and 
adjustment to post-op life. 

This is not the place to discuss immediate post-op recovery issues. For 
discussion including early post-op problems, see the DS_PostOp_Problems list 
at the following URL: 

http://groups.yahoo.com/group/DS_PostOp_Problems/join 

For general open discussion, please join the main DS list at the following URL: 

http://groups.yahoo.com/group/duodenalswitch/join
